description: Task frame C has +x from the robot toward Xiaolan, +y along the Xiaolan edge, and +z along the photovoltaic-panel support-plane normal. Its fixed origin and +y sign reference remain unresolved. Gravity need not align with C.-z. Terminal-axis and geometry-projected support values are model diagnostics only and never prove contact, load, friction, or stability.

task_frame_C.origin: unresolved fixed physical reference; see unknown.task_frame_origin_climb_m
task_frame_C.+x: from robot toward Xiaolan at the predefined climb start pose
task_frame_C.+y: along Xiaolan edge; positive sign reference unresolved
task_frame_C.gravity_note: gravity need not align with C.-z

semantics.foot_contact_model: The foot lower contact is hemispherical and the upper part is cylindrical. Terminal-axis error is the angle between -ankle_to_foot_axis and the outward surface normal; zero is the desired central/pole orientation, not contact or load evidence.
semantics.support_projection: Geometry-projected support is a necessary diagnostic only. It is insufficient for inclined or non-coplanar friction/contact-wrench feasibility and never proves contact or load.
semantics.lora_transport: LoRa transports Xiaolan RTK messages. Transport freshness, ordering, integrity, and latency are separate from the RTK solution's spatial uncertainty.

xiaolan_cad_low_contact.selector_tolerance_semantics: Selector normal and plane-offset tolerances are binary-STL numerical matching tolerances only; they are not physical safety margins or contact clearances.

known_notes.deck_height_nominal_m: Approximate physical measurement; tolerance and reference points are unresolved.
known_notes.rm_motor_envelope_rough_range_m: Rough thigh-motor/hip-envelope observation, not foot reach.
known_notes.foot_center_delta_nominal_m: Nominal Q_STAND foot-center difference, distinct from motor envelope.
known_notes.model_foot_radius_m: Model-only value, not measured real-foot geometry.

offline_analysis.blocked_by: M2/M3 offline search and certification are blocked by required physical inputs: task frame C, deck/edge/safe region, body/camera/motor envelopes, measured real-foot geometry, real COM uncertainty, friction, and loaded LX-15D behavior remain unresolved.
